high_value_findings.finding: A ground-truth SystemRealityLayer reduced some confabulation risk but universal idle-prompt injection caused the model to echo the control block; it was removed from that path in the next historical revision.
high_value_findings.transfer: Ground truth needs task-specific routing/salience and post-generation validation; more truth-context is not monotonically better.

high_value_findings.finding: Internal autonomous-research and summarization calls exposed contract/data-plane mistakes: nonexistent memory API and a maintenance prompt persisted as visible user chat.
high_value_findings.transfer: Internal LLM jobs need explicit non-conversational channels, no-persist/default-isolation semantics, and machine-checkable storage contracts.

high_value_findings.finding: Behavioral screenshots and a 70-turn quantitative ablation were used for strong claims, then the ablation was explicitly removed and replaced by raw no-claims excerpts; later README language added caveats and removed persuasion/comparative claims.
high_value_findings.transfer: Evidence-class downgrades, retractions and supersession must dominate older claim artifacts in research synthesis.

high_value_findings.finding: Aggressive response regex cleaning could delete legitimate answers; the fix added a retained-content ratio guard. Neural Reality Gate also used cold-start rule fallback and blending.
high_value_findings.transfer: Validators/filters need measurable collateral-damage guards, cold-start fallback, and outcome feedback rather than binary trust in learned filters.

high_value_findings.finding: Installer, recovery, updater and documentation diverged from the live system in services, ports, models, paths and entity/rooms topology, then required broad reconciliation.
high_value_findings.transfer: Generate deployment/recovery/docs topology from an authoritative manifest where possible; otherwise require contract tests and document epochs.

high_value_findings.finding: Forty-eight live databases, including personality/state databases, were snapshotted as seed databases for release/recovery.
high_value_findings.transfer: Bootstrap/reference seed state must carry provenance and remain categorically separate from runtime/user identity state to prevent identity cloning or stale-state promotion.

negative_results_preserved: Ground-truth context became prompt-leak material when injected into idle-thought prompts.
Autonomous research targeted a nonexistent memory endpoint.
Internal summary prompts polluted persistent user-visible chat history.
Response-cleaning regexes over-stripped legitimate philosophical content.
Deployment/recovery/update maps drifted materially from live topology.
A previously promoted quantitative ablation artifact was later removed and its evidence class downgraded.
Runtime support and architecture documentation changed enough across adjacent commits that docs cannot be treated as timeless truth.
measurement_boundary: Source-reported benchmark percentages, latencies, fix counts and rejection rates were not independently reproduced. The historical ablation metrics at k153 are explicitly superseded in evidence status by k150.

earned_work.reason: No row-level earned-work overlap audit was performed.

next_falsifiers: A/B task-routed versus universal reality-context injection measuring factual correction and control-tag leakage separately.
Enforce no-persist internal LLM channel and test that maintenance prompts never enter chat/session memory.
Replay response filters against a labeled corpus and measure legitimate-content deletion rate.
Reconstruct any claimed ablation from immutable raw prompts/outputs/configs before restoring quantitative evidence status.
Generate updater/recovery/service health maps from one authoritative topology manifest and test drift detection.
Boot from seed DBs and verify runtime identity/user state cannot be confused with reference bootstrap provenance.
